one_liner: Work operating system for building custom project and workflow management apps.

auth.evidence_quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
auth.notes: Primary auth doc emphasizes personal API tokens for single-account use; OAuth2 (documented separately at developer.monday.com/apps/docs/oauth, including a newer OAuth 2.1 flow) is the mechanism for apps acting on other users' accounts.

access.evidence_quote: create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing
access.notes: Free developer sandbox account available; OAuth apps installed into another account require that account's admin to authorize during the OAuth consent flow.

api.evidence_quote: Personal tokens are user-specific and mirror all permission levels set in the monday.com UI
api.notes: GraphQL single-endpoint API; monday.com documents controlling MCP access via OAuth app.

verdict.rationale: Free developer sandbox and both API-token and OAuth2 flows are documented; acting on another workspace requires that workspace's admin consent.
